headline: Is Hormel Foods (HRL) Cheap Following John Ghingo's CEO Appointment?
summary: Hormel Foods (HRL) is back in focus after the board confirmed president John Ghingo will become chief executive officer in October 2026. Investors are weighing what this leadership change could mean for the stock. See our latest analysis for Hormel Foods.
